name: Sagittarius A*
mass_note: GRAVITY 2022: 4.297e6 ±0.012e6 (stat) ±0.040e6 (sys); combined in quadrature here. EHT ring-based: 4.0(+1.1/-0.6)e6.
spin_note: Not directly measured. EHT 2022 GRMHD model scoring favours a*>0 (~0.5-0.94, MAD, prograde) with i<50 deg; Wong et al. 2025 polarimetry disfavours very high spin. S301 (GRAVITY+ 2026) may measure spin within ~10 yr.
spin_method: model comparison (EHT GRMHD library); not a measurement
distance_note: R0 = 8277 ±9 (stat) ±33 (sys) pc (GRAVITY 2022). Reid et al. 2019 (masers): 8.15 ±0.15 kpc.
inclination_note: NIR flare hot-spot orbits: i ~150-160 deg (near face-on, clockwise) (GRAVITY 2018, 2023). EHT models favour i < 50 deg (equivalently >130 deg).
accretion_state: quiescent (radiatively inefficient, flaring daily in NIR/X-ray)
luminosity_note: L_bol ~ (6.8-9.2)e35 erg/s (EHT Sgr A* Paper II 2022); L/L_Edd ~ 1e-9 (L_Edd ~ 5.4e44 erg/s for 4.3e6 Msun, derived).
fact: Discovered as a compact radio source by Balick & Brown in Feb 1974; EHT released its first image on 12 May 2022 (data from April 2017) and its first polarized image on 27 March 2024.
fact_ko: 1974년 2월 Balick과 Brown이 전파원으로 발견했고, EHT가 2022년 5월 12일 첫 영상(2017년 4월 관측)을, 2024년 3월 27일 편광 영상을 공개했다.
refs: GRAVITY Collaboration (Abuter R. et al.) 2022, A&A 657, L12, arXiv:2112.07478
GRAVITY Collaboration 2021, A&A 647, A59, arXiv:2101.12098 (R0 = 8275 ±9 ±33 pc)

name: M87* (Messier 87 nucleus)
mass_note: EHT 2019: 6.5 ±0.2 (stat) ±0.7 (sys) e9. Contested: stellar dynamics 6.6±0.4e9 (Gebhardt 2011), 5.37(+0.37/-0.25)e9 (Liepold 2023); gas dynamics 3.5e9 (Walsh 2013).
spin_note: Not measured. EHT 2017/2018/2021 ring asymmetry with MAD models marginally disfavours |a*| <~ 0.2 (EHT/Bernshteyn 2026); polarimetry favours low-to-intermediate spin (Wong 2025). Spin vector points away from Earth (clockwise ring rotation).
inclination_note: Jet viewing angle ~17 deg (Walker et al. 2018: 17 ±2 deg; Mertens 2016 ~18 deg).
accretion_state: active, low-luminosity AGN (radiatively inefficient, powerful jet)
luminosity_note: Mdot ~ (3-20)e-4 Msun/yr at the horizon, jet power ~1e42-1e44 erg/s (EHT 2021 Paper VIII); L/L_Edd ~ 1e-5 order of magnitude.
fact: Its jet was first noted by Heber Curtis in 1918; on 10 April 2019 the EHT released the first-ever image of a black hole shadow (M87*, 2017 data), ring diameter 42 ±3 microarcsec.
fact_ko: 1918년 커티스가 제트를 처음 기록했고, 2019년 4월 10일 EHT가 인류 최초의 블랙홀 그림자 영상(링 지름 42±3 μas)을 공개했다.
refs: EHT Collaboration 2019, ApJL 875, L1 (Paper I) and L6 (Paper VI)
EHT Collaboration 2021, ApJL 910, L13 (Paper VIII, polarization)
EHT Collaboration 2024, A&A 681, A79 (2018 image)

Curtis H.D. 1918, Publ. Lick Obs. 13, 9

name: M31* (Andromeda nucleus)
mass_note: Bender et al. 2005 (HST STIS, P3 disk dynamics), 1-sigma.
spin_note: Not measured.
distance_note: HST Cepheids (Li et al. 2021); older consensus ~765-785 kpc.
coord_ref: Optical/IR nucleus position (approx., 2MASS/NED); M31* is the VLA source in P2 (Crane et al. 1992), within <~0.2 arcsec
inclination_note: Galaxy disk inclination ~77 deg; the nuclear P3 disk is roughly aligned with the galaxy disk (Bender 2005).
accretion_state: quiescent / extremely sub-Eddington, with occasional X-ray flares (2006 outburst)
luminosity_note: X-ray (0.5-8 keV) ~1e36 erg/s quiescent; ~1e-10 L_Edd (Li et al. 2011).
fact: The radio source M31* was found with the VLA in 1992; the double nucleus (P1/P2) was resolved by HST in 1993 and is explained as an eccentric stellar disk orbiting the black hole.
fact_ko: 1992년 VLA로 전파원이 발견되었고, 1993년 허블이 이중 핵(P1/P2)을 분해했는데 이는 블랙홀을 도는 이심 항성 원반으로 설명된다.
refs: Bender R. et al. 2005, ApJ 631, 280
Li S. et al. 2021, ApJ 920, 84
Li Z. et al. 2011, ApJL 728, L10, arXiv:1011.1224
Crane P.C., Dickel J.R., Cowan J.J. 1992, ApJL 390, L9
Lauer T.R. et al. 1993, AJ 106, 1436

name: Cygnus X-1
mass_note: Miller-Jones et al. 2021 (1-sigma). CONTESTED: Ramachandran et al. 2025 (UV/optical spectroscopy of the donor) find donor ~29 Msun and M_BH 12.7-17.8 Msun depending on inclination.
spin_note: a* > 0.9985 (3-sigma lower limit), continuum fitting with the 2021 mass/distance/inclination (Zhao et al. 2021). Reflection fits also give a* > 0.9 in most studies; continuum-fitting systematics are debated.
inclination_note: Orbital inclination (Miller-Jones 2021). Ramachandran 2025 argue for a different value; mass depends steeply on i.
accretion_state: active, persistent (wind-fed; mostly hard state, switches to soft)
fact: Discovered by a sounding-rocket X-ray flight in 1964; it was the subject of Stephen Hawking's 1974 bet with Kip Thorne that it was NOT a black hole, which Hawking conceded in 1990.
fact_ko: 1964년 로켓 X선 관측으로 발견되었고, 1974년 호킹이 '블랙홀이 아니다'에 건 손 내기(킵 손과)의 대상이었으며 호킹은 1990년 패배를 인정했다.
refs: Miller-Jones J.C.A. et al. 2021, Science 371, 1046, arXiv:2102.09091
Ramachandran V. et al. 2025, A&A 698, A37, arXiv:2504.05885
Bowyer S. et al. 1965, Science 147, 394
Webster B.L. & Murdin P. 1972, Nature 235, 37
Bolton C.T. 1972, Nature 235, 271

name: V404 Cygni (GS 2023+338)
mass_note: Khargharia et al. 2010 (NIR light curves).
spin_note: Reflection fits during 2015 outburst suggest high spin (a* > 0.92, Walton et al. 2017) - model dependent.
distance_note: First VLBI parallax distance to a BH (Miller-Jones 2009).
luminosity_note: Quiescent L_X ~ 1e33 erg/s; reached ~Eddington in June 2015.

companion.name: V404 Cyg B
companion.tertiary: Wide tertiary (~1.2 Msun evolved star) at >=3500 AU, outer period ~70,000 yr (Burdge et al. 2024) - evidence the BH formed without a strong natal kick.

fact: Recorded as Nova Cygni 1938 and detected in X-rays by Ginga in May 1989; in 2024 a distant third star bound to the system was found, implying the BH formed with almost no natal kick.
fact_ko: 1938년 신성으로 기록되고 1989년 긴가 위성이 X선으로 발견했으며, 2024년 멀리서 공전하는 세 번째 별이 발견되어 거의 반동 없이 태어났음이 시사되었다.
refs: Khargharia J., Froning C.S., Robinson E.L. 2010, ApJ 716, 1105
Miller-Jones J.C.A. et al. 2009, ApJL 706, L230
Burdge K.B. et al. 2024, Nature 635, 316
Walton D.J. et al. 2017, ApJ 839, 110
Makino F. (Ginga) 1989, IAU Circ. 4782

name: A0620-00 (V616 Monocerotis)
mass_note: Cantrell et al. 2010. Revised 5.86 ±0.24 Msun by van Grunsven et al. 2017 (disc-contamination correction) - values disagree.
spin_note: Low spin, continuum fitting (Gou et al. 2010).
distance_note: Cantrell 2010. Was the nearest known BH until Gaia BH1 (2022).
fact: Its 1975 X-ray outburst (Ariel 5) made it briefly the brightest X-ray source in the sky; in 1986 McClintock & Remillard showed its compact object exceeds 3 Msun.
fact_ko: 1975년 아리엘 5호가 포착한 폭발 때 한동안 하늘에서 가장 밝은 X선원이었고, 1986년 동반성 운동으로 3태양질량 초과가 확인되었다.
refs: Cantrell A.G. et al. 2010, ApJ 710, 1127
van Grunsven T.F.J. et al. 2017, MNRAS 472, 1907
Gou L. et al. 2010, ApJL 718, L122
McClintock J.E. & Remillard R.A. 1986, ApJ 308, 110
Elvis M. et al. 1975, Nature 257, 656

name: GRS 1915+105 (V1487 Aql)
mass_note: Reid et al. 2014 (VLBA parallax + Steeghs 2013 dynamics).
spin_note: a* > 0.98 (McClintock et al. 2006, continuum fitting); reflection studies also give high spin.
accretion_state: active since 1992 (near-Eddington for decades); since 2018 in a faint, heavily obscured state
fact: Discovered by the WATCH monitor on GRANAT on 15 Aug 1992; in 1994 it became the first Galactic source seen to eject 'superluminal' jets (Mirabel & Rodriguez).
fact_ko: 1992년 8월 15일 GRANAT 위성이 발견했고, 1994년 우리은하 최초로 '초광속' 겉보기 운동 제트가 관측되었다.
refs: Reid M.J. et al. 2014, ApJ 796, 2
Steeghs D. et al. 2013, ApJ 768, 185
McClintock J.E. et al. 2006, ApJ 652, 518
Mirabel I.F. & Rodriguez L.F. 1994, Nature 371, 46
Castro-Tirado A.J. et al. 1992, IAU Circ. 5590

name: GX 339-4 (V821 Ara)
mass_note: Poorly constrained: 2.3 < M < 9.5 Msun (Heida et al. 2017, f(M)=1.91±0.08); Zdziarski et al. 2019 give ~4-11 Msun.
spin_note: X-ray reflection (Garcia et al. 2015); Parker et al. 2016: 0.95(+0.02/-0.08). Model dependent.
accretion_state: recurrent transient (outbursts every ~2-3 yr; archetype of hard/soft state cycle 'q-diagram')
luminosity_note: Ranges from ~1e-6 to ~0.3 L_Edd over an outburst.
fact: Discovered with OSO-7 in 1973; its repeated outbursts are the textbook example of black-hole X-ray binaries tracing a 'q'-shaped hardness-intensity loop.
fact_ko: 1973년 OSO-7 위성이 발견했고, 반복 폭발이 그리는 'q'자 모양 경도-세기 도표는 블랙홀 X선 쌍성의 교과서적 예시다.
refs: Heida M. et al. 2017, ApJ 846, 132
Zdziarski A.A. et al. 2019, MNRAS 488, 1026, arXiv:1904.07803
Garcia J.A. et al. 2015, ApJ 813, 84
Parker M.L. et al. 2016, ApJL 821, L6
Markert T.H. et al. 1973, ApJL 184, L67
Corral-Santana J.M. et al. 2016, A&A 587, A61 (BlackCAT)

name: MAXI J1820+070 (ASASSN-18ey)
mass_note: Torres et al. 2020 using jet inclination 63±3 deg; mass function alone allows ~5.7-8.3 Msun for i=66-81 deg.
spin_note: CONTESTED: continuum fitting a*=0.14±0.09 (Zhao et al. 2021) vs. high spin (~0.8-0.99) from some reflection fits.
inclination_note: Jet inclination (Atri 2020); orbital 66-81 deg (Torres 2019/2020) - possible spin-orbit misalignment.
accretion_state: transient; returned to quiescence 2023 after 2018-2019 outburst
fact: First seen optically by ASAS-SN on 6 Mar 2018 and in X-rays by MAXI on 11 Mar 2018, it became one of the brightest X-ray transients ever and the source of a famous 'echo' of reverberating X-rays (NICER, Kara et al. 2019).
fact_ko: 2018년 3월 6일 ASAS-SN, 11일 MAXI가 발견했고, NICER가 원반 근처 X선 '메아리'(반향)를 측정한 대표 천체다.
refs: Torres M.A.P. et al. 2020, ApJL 893, L37
Torres M.A.P. et al. 2019, ApJL 882, L21
Atri P. et al. 2020, MNRAS 493, L81
Zhao X. et al. 2021, ApJ 916, 108
Tucker M.A. et al. 2018, ApJL 867, L9
Kara E. et al. 2019, Nature 565, 198

name: Gaia BH1 (Gaia DR3 4373465352415301632)
mass_note: El-Badry et al. 2023a. Refined to 9.27 ±0.10 Msun with ESPRESSO RVs (Nagarajan et al. 2024).
spin_note: Not measurable (no accretion).
distance_note: Gaia parallax; ~1560 ly. Nearest known black hole (as of Oct 2026).
fact: Announced in November 2022 from Gaia DR3 astrometry, it is the nearest known black hole (~480 pc) and the first dormant BH with a Sun-like star.
fact_ko: 2022년 11월 가이아 DR3 천체측정으로 발표된, 지구에서 가장 가까운 블랙홀(약 1560광년)이며 태양 같은 별을 거느린 최초의 '잠든' 블랙홀이다.
refs: El-Badry K. et al. 2023, MNRAS 518, 1057, arXiv:2209.06833
Nagarajan P. et al. 2024, PASP 136, 014202, arXiv:2312.05313
Chakrabarti S. et al. 2023, AJ 166, 6

name: Gaia BH2 (Gaia DR3 5870569352746779008)
mass_note: El-Badry et al. 2023b.
spin_note: Not measurable.
fact: Reported in 2023, it has the longest orbital period (~3.5 yr) of any known BH binary at discovery, around a red giant in Centaurus.
fact_ko: 2023년 보고된, 센타우루스자리 적색거성과 약 3.5년 주기로 도는 잠든 블랙홀이다.
refs: El-Badry K. et al. 2023, MNRAS 521, 4323, arXiv:2302.07880
Hey D., Li Y., Ong J. 2025, AJ 170, 304
Tanikawa A. et al. 2023, ApJ 946, 79

name: Gaia BH3 (Gaia DR3 4318465066420528000)
mass_note: Panuzzo et al. 2024 (Gaia Collaboration). Most massive stellar BH known in the Milky Way.
spin_note: Not measurable.
distance_note: Gaia parallax (~1926 ly). Second-nearest known BH.
fact: Announced on 16 April 2024 from pre-release Gaia DR4 data in Aquila; the BH is part of the disrupted ED-2 star cluster in the Galactic halo.
fact_ko: 2024년 4월 16일 가이아 DR4 사전 데이터로 발표되었으며, 우리은하 헤일로의 해체된 ED-2 성단에 속한다.
refs: Gaia Collaboration (Panuzzo P. et al.) 2024, A&A 686, L2, arXiv:2404.10486
Balbinot E. et al. 2024, A&A 687, L3, arXiv:2404.11604
ESO press release eso2408 (16 Apr 2024)

name: Omega Centauri IMBH
mass_note: Firm lower limit ~8,200 Msun from 7 fast stars (Häberle et al. 2024); dynamical models favour a few 1e4 Msun (~4e4).
spin_note: Not measured.
coord_ref: Cluster centre (Anderson & van der Marel 2010), approx.
fact: In July 2024, 20 years of HST data revealed seven stars moving faster than escape velocity in the cluster core, the best evidence yet for an intermediate-mass black hole in the Milky Way.
fact_ko: 2024년 7월 20년간의 허블 자료에서 탈출속도보다 빠른 별 7개가 발견되어 우리은하 중간질량 블랙홀의 가장 강력한 증거가 되었다.
refs: Häberle M. et al. 2024, Nature 631, 285, arXiv:2405.06015
Baumgardt H. & Vasiliev E. 2021, MNRAS 505, 5957

name: TON 618
mass_note: CONTESTED single-epoch virial estimates: 6.6e10 Msun (Shemmer et al. 2004, H-beta) vs 4.07e10 (Ge et al. 2019, C IV). Systematic uncertainty ~0.3-0.5 dex.
spin_note: Not measured.
distance_note: z = 2.219. Derived (Planck18, flat LCDM): D_L ~ 18.1 Gpc, comoving ~ 5.6 Gpc, light-travel ~ 10.8 Gyr.
luminosity_note: L_bol ~ 4e47 erg/s (~4e40 W, M_abs ~ -30.7); L/L_Edd ~ 0.05-0.1 implied (derived, highly uncertain).
fact: Catalogued in 1957 as a faint blue star (entry 618 of the Tonantzintla survey), it was recognised as a quasar in the 1970s; ALMA in 2021 found a ~100 kpc Lyman-alpha nebula around it.
fact_ko: 1957년 토난친틀라 목록 618번 '푸른 별'로 등록되었다가 1970년대 퀘이사로 밝혀졌고, 2021년 ALMA가 약 100 kpc 라이먼 알파 성운을 확인했다.
refs: Shemmer O. et al. 2004, ApJ 614, 547
Li J. et al. 2021, ApJL 922, L29
Iriarte B. & Chavira E. 1957, Bol. Obs. Tonantzintla Tacubaya 2, 3

name: Holmberg 15A*
mass_note: Direct stellar-dynamical measurement (Mehrgan et al. 2019, MUSE).
spin_note: Not measured.
fact: Its galaxy has one of the largest stellar cores known (~2.2 kpc), carved out as the black hole ejected stars; the 4e10 Msun mass (2019) is among the largest measured dynamically.
fact_ko: 블랙홀이 별들을 밀어내 만든 약 2.2 kpc의 거대한 핵을 가진 은하로, 2019년 동역학으로 잰 질량 400억 태양질량은 측정치 중 최대급이다.
refs: Mehrgan K. et al. 2019, ApJ 887, 195, arXiv:1907.10608
López-Cruz O. et al. 2014, ApJL 795, L31

name: Cosmic Horseshoe lens galaxy BH (SDSS J1148+1930)
mass_note: log M = 10.56 (+0.07/-0.08 stat) ±0.12 sys (Melo-Carneiro et al. 2025) via lensing + stellar dynamics; error bars here combine stat+sys approx. Claimed most massive BH with a direct-type measurement (2025).
spin_note: Not measured.
fact: Announced in 2025: the radial lensed counter-image near the galaxy centre, combined with MUSE stellar kinematics, required a ~36 billion solar-mass black hole (5-sigma).
fact_ko: 2025년, 은하 중심 근처의 렌즈 상과 MUSE 별 운동을 결합해 약 360억 태양질량 블랙홀이 5시그마로 검출되었다.
refs: Melo-Carneiro C.R. et al. 2025, MNRAS, doi:10.1093/mnras/staf1036, arXiv:2502.13788

name: Phoenix A (Phoenix Cluster BCG)
mass_note: NOT CREDIBLE AS A MEASUREMENT: order-of-magnitude estimate (~1e11) from feedback-growth + N-body core-scouring models (Brockamp et al. 2016). No dynamical/virial measurement exists. Do not present as fact.
accretion_state: active (obscured quasar-like AGN, strong cooling flow)
fact: The Phoenix Cluster (found by the South Pole Telescope in 2010) hosts a record cooling flow and starburst; its BH mass is only a model estimate.
fact_ko: 남극망원경이 2010년 발견한 피닉스 은하단 중심 은하로, 블랙홀 질량은 모델 추정치일 뿐이다.
refs: Brockamp M. et al. 2016, A&A 585, A153, arXiv:1509.04782
McDonald M. et al. 2012, Nature 488, 349

name: GW150914 remnant
mass_note: Source-frame final mass (GWTC-1). Components 35.6(+4.7/-3.1) + 30.6(+3.0/-4.4) Msun. ~3.1 Msun radiated as GWs.
spin_note: Remnant spin from inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform (GWTC-1), 90% CI.
coord_ref: Poorly localized: ~600 deg^2 (90%) in the southern sky (2-detector).
fact: Detected on 14 Sep 2015 09:50:45 UTC and announced 11 Feb 2016, it was the first direct detection of gravitational waves and of a binary black hole merger (Nobel Prize 2017).
fact_ko: 2015년 9월 14일 09:50:45 UTC 검출, 2016년 2월 11일 발표된 최초의 중력파 직접 검출이자 블랙홀 병합 관측이다(2017년 노벨상).
refs: Abbott B.P. et al. (LVC) 2016, PRL 116, 061102, arXiv:1602.03837
Abbott B.P. et al. (LVC) 2019, PRX 9, 031040 (GWTC-1), arXiv:1811.12907
Abbott B.P. et al. 2016, PRL 116, 241102, arXiv:1602.03840

name: GW190521 remnant
mass_note: Components 85(+21/-14) + 66(+17/-18) Msun; primary in the pair-instability gap. ~8 Msun radiated. First clear IMBH formation observed.
spin_note: Remnant spin, 90% CI.
accretion_state: no matter (possible AGN-disk environment; ZTF19abanrhr flare association unconfirmed)
fact: Detected on 21 May 2019 (published 2 Sep 2020), it produced a ~142 Msun remnant, the first intermediate-mass black hole whose formation was directly observed.
fact_ko: 2019년 5월 21일 검출(2020년 9월 발표)되어 약 142 태양질량의 잔해를 남긴, 탄생이 직접 관측된 최초의 중간질량 블랙홀이다.
refs: Abbott R. et al. (LVC) 2020, PRL 125, 101102, arXiv:2009.01075
Abbott R. et al. 2020, ApJL 900, L13, arXiv:2009.01190
Graham M.J. et al. 2020, PRL 124, 251102 (candidate counterpart)

name: GW231123 (GW231123_135430) and its remnant
mass_note: Remnant mass. Total source-frame mass 238(+28/-49) Msun (abstract range 190-265) - most massive BBH confidently detected (as of Oct 2026). Components m1 = 137(+23/-18) and m2 = 101(+22/-50) Msun. Large waveform systematics.
spin_note: Remnant spin (90% HPD). Component spins chi1 ~0.9(+0.10/-0.19), chi2 ~0.80(+0.20/-0.52) - among highest measured in GW.
spin_method: GW waveform (IMR), confirmed by independent ringdown analysis
fact: Detected on 23 Nov 2023 13:54:30 UTC and announced in July 2025, its ~137 Msun primary lies in or above the pair-instability gap, suggesting it was itself a product of earlier mergers.
fact_ko: 2023년 11월 23일 검출, 2025년 7월 발표된 역대 최대 질량 블랙홀 쌍성 병합으로, 1차 블랙홀이 쌍불안정 질량 간극 안에 있어 이전 병합의 산물일 가능성이 있다.
refs: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (Abac A.G. et al.) 2025, ApJL (GW231123: a Binary Black Hole Merger with Total Mass 190-265 Msun), arXiv:2507.08219

name: GW250114 (GW250114_082203) remnant
mass_note: Components 33.6(+1.2/-0.8) + 32.2(+0.8/-1.3) Msun; component spins <= 0.26; eccentricity <= 0.03. Nearly a twin of GW150914.
spin_note: Remnant spin, 90% CI. Ringdown: fundamental (220) mode + first overtone (221) detected at 4.1 sigma; Kerr frequencies confirmed within ~30%.
distance_note: z = 0.09±0.01; D_L ~ 425 Mpc is DERIVED from z with Planck18 (not quoted from the paper). Press: ~1.3 billion light-years.

area_theorem.note: Remnant horizon area exceeds total initial area 'at high credibility' (PRL 135, 111403); press-quoted values ~240,000 km^2 -> ~400,000 km^2.

fact: Detected on 14 Jan 2025 08:22:03 UTC with network SNR ~80 (loudest GW signal ever), it gave the clearest confirmation of Hawking's 1971 black-hole area theorem, published Sep 2025.
fact_ko: 2025년 1월 14일 08:22:03 UTC 검출된 역대 가장 선명한 신호(SNR 약 80)로, 1971년 호킹의 블랙홀 면적 정리를 가장 명확하게 확인했다(2025년 9월 발표).
refs: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (Abac A.G. et al.) 2025, PRL 135, 111403, doi:10.1103/kw5g-d732, arXiv:2509.08054
LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration 2026, PRL 136, 041403, doi:10.1103/6c61-fm1n, arXiv:2509.08099
LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration 2026, GWTC-5.0 Results, arXiv:2605.27225
Hawking S.W. 1971, PRL 26, 1344

name: GW241011 (GW241011_233834) primary
mass_note: Components m1 = 19.6(+3.6/-2.5), m2 = 5.9±0.8 Msun (90%). Remnant mass not quoted in summary.
spin_note: PRIMARY spin chi1 (not remnant); tilted ~31 deg. Used to exclude a range of ultralight boson masses.
fact: Detected 11 Oct 2024 (published 28 Oct 2025 with GW241110), it is among the best evidence for a 'second-generation' black hole born in an earlier merger.
fact_ko: 2024년 10월 11일 검출(2025년 10월 발표)되어 이전 병합에서 태어난 '2세대' 블랙홀의 유력한 증거가 되었다.
refs: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (Abac A.G. et al.) 2025, ApJL 993, L21, doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae0d54

name: GW241110 (GW241110_124123) primary
spin_note: PRIMARY spin; misaligned by >110 deg, i.e. anti-aligned with the orbit - first such case.
fact: Detected 10 Nov 2024, it is the first BBH whose primary spins opposite to the orbit, a signature of dynamical/hierarchical assembly.
fact_ko: 2024년 11월 10일 검출된, 1차 블랙홀이 궤도와 반대로 자전하는 최초의 사례다.
refs: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration (Abac A.G. et al.) 2025, ApJL 993, L21, doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae0d54

name: CAPERS-LRD-z9
mass_note: log M = 7.58 ±0.15 (H-beta virial); conservative range 6.65-8.50 dex (Taylor et al. 2025). Popular reports of '300 million' are inconsistent with the paper.
distance_note: z = 9.288; ~520 Myr after the Big Bang (derived, Planck18). Most distant spectroscopically confirmed broad-line AGN as of its publication (2025).
fact: Reported in 2025 from JWST/NIRSpec, it is the most distant confirmed black hole in a 'little red dot', seen ~500 Myr after the Big Bang.
fact_ko: 2025년 JWST 분광으로 확인된, 빅뱅 약 5억 년 후의 '리틀 레드 닷' 속 가장 먼 확정 블랙홀이다.
refs: Taylor A.J. et al. 2025, ApJL 989, L7, arXiv:2505.04609

name: Abell2744-QSO1
mass_note: log M = 7.7 ±0.3, DYNAMICAL (Keplerian narrow-line rotation; Juodžbalis et al. 2026, Nature). M_BH/M_star > 2 ('naked' BH).
distance_note: z = 7.04 (~750 Myr after Big Bang, derived). Triply lensed by Abell 2744.
fact: In 2025-26 it became the first black hole in the epoch of reionisation with a direct dynamical mass, and its host is nearly pristine gas with almost no stars.
fact_ko: 2025년 재이온화 시대 블랙홀 중 최초로 동역학적 질량이 측정되었고, 별이 거의 없는 원시 가스 속 '벌거벗은' 블랙홀이다.
refs: Maiolino R. et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.22567
Furtak L.J. et al. 2024, Nature 628, 57

name: MoM-BH*-1
mass_note: ~1e6-1e7 Msun (Naidu et al.); the authors argue LRD masses may be overestimated.
coord_ref: Naidu et al. (degrees given; sexagesimal converted)
luminosity_note: Naive L/L_Edd ~18%; authors suggest true ratio may be ~5-10x Eddington.
fact: Published in Nature in Aug 2026, it is interpreted as a 'black hole star' - an accreting black hole cocooned in dense gas that mimics a giant star, possibly explaining JWST's little red dots.
fact_ko: 2026년 8월 네이처에 발표된, 짙은 가스에 싸여 거대한 별처럼 보이는 '블랙홀 별'로 JWST 리틀 레드 닷의 정체를 설명할 수 있다.

name: UHZ1
mass_note: ~1e7-1e8 Msun from X-ray luminosity assuming Eddington (Bogdán et al. 2024).
fact: Detected by Chandra + JWST in 2023, it is the most distant black hole seen in X-rays and is a leading candidate for a 'heavy seed' (direct-collapse) black hole.
fact_ko: 2023년 찬드라와 JWST가 함께 포착한 X선으로 본 가장 먼 블랙홀로, '무거운 씨앗(직접 붕괴)' 블랙홀의 유력 후보다.
refs: Bogdán Á. et al. 2024, Nature Astronomy 8, 126, arXiv:2305.15458
Goulding A.D. et al. 2023, ApJL 955, L24, arXiv:2308.02750
